comparison.objective: Wipe two marked patches in order without disturbing an intervening cup.
comparison.physical_skill: Sponge grasping, ordered surface wiping, obstacle avoidance, and return placement.
comparison.success_condition: Left then right patch cleared, cup unmoved, sponge returned to START; setup and scoring thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: Surface coverage and obstacle preservation do not test coaxial tool insertion, hammer impact, fracture, or loose-metal recovery.
